global: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth, topped with chashu pork, menma, and a pink-naruto fish cake, alongside a dark nori sheet. Served in a white bowl, it rests on a dark wooden table under warm, ambient lighting.

regions.background: The background shows a dark brown wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and slight reflections.
regions.bowl: The white ceramic ramen bowl has a smooth, slightly glossy surface with a rounded, shallow shape.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with sliced pork, bamboo shoots, and a pink-topped fish cake, all floating in rich, golden-brown liquid.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, triangular-shaped, with a slightly uneven surface and visible grainy details.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is browned, tender-looking, and irregularly shaped with visible seasoning specks on its surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, slightly translucent, with fibrous texture and irregular, curved shapes.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white, soft, round, with pink swirl pattern on top, slightly textured surface.
